management_basis_statement: 6323の研究管理日は2027-01-15（Asia/Tokyo）。固定著者の四半期レビューを研究段階へ適応し、新保存時は前倒しする。会社発表日・売却期限ではない。
parent_review_scope: Read fixed comparison and presentation addendum; reused completed source and fact independent checks. Parent additionally viewed p20 timeline and AP p24/25 product/application images; no complete-PDF meaning audit.

research_results.IR: Publicly answered general descriptions excluded. No new question draft, model input paths, price action or financial adoption.
research_results.demand: Interim observation directionally consistent only; issuer forward order outlook is not realization or full-year forecast success.
research_results.factory: Issuer-internal advance plan preserved as plain year/Q. General domestic/overseas Q definitions public, assignment to factory chart and old broker comparison still unknown. Plan is not actual completion or operation.
research_results.period_wording: Earlier calendar-year wording qualified by sidecar and independent addendum; original source untouched.
research_results.supply: Public procurement/staffing/space responses and AP product examples; supply/profit effects, AP sales/adoption/order mix unconfirmed.

temporal_boundary: Observation-after-source retrospective research. Original v14 baseline followed raw-PDF reading and was not blind. Presentation also reviewed before its initial DB save; no predictive-performance claim.
